company.name: Bevel
company.tagline: We de-risk modernization of critical legacy applications.
company.description:
At Bevel, our mission is to create the most fulfilling workforce in the world, by empowering our workers with unique opportunities for meaningful work. For us, that means tackling one of the most pressing problems in our generation: the innovation bottleneck of legacy code.

As such, we help companies unlock the full potential of their legacy code. Bevel's AI tool enables developer teams work more efficiently with complex codebases by helping them extract, understand and trace the embedded business logic.

Whether you're a small team or a large enterprise facing the complexity of legacy software, Bevel provides a seamless, secure, and scalable solution. Together, we can turn legacy code into an opportunity for growth, innovation, and a more fulfilling work environment for your teams. Let's transform your legacy systems and drive your business forward.
